title: Sci-Fi
story: Rockets, saucers and glowing gadgets from the big screen.

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A tall white rocket with a pointed red nose cone, a round porthole window, three red fins at the base and a flat nozzle, flying upright.
cards.hero_colors: white, red, small yellow ring around the porthole

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A perfectly round silver flying saucer: a flat disc body with a smooth glass dome on top and a ring of small round lights around the rim.
cards.hero_colors: silver, grey, small orange lights on the rim

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white astronaut helmet with a large curved gold-mirrored visor and a thick neck ring at the bottom.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold visor, small red stripe on the neck ring

cards.name: Glow Flask
cards.subject: A round-bottomed lab flask with a long narrow neck, half full of bright glowing green liquid with a few bubbles, a cork stopper in the neck.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, green liquid, light brown cork, small yellow bubbles

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A small six-wheeled rover with a boxy silver body, a flat solar panel on top and a short mast with a round camera, standing on grey dust.
cards.hero_colors: silver, grey, black wheels, small orange mast cap

cards.name: Star Map
cards.subject: A flat rectangular blue paper map seen from above, with small yellow star icons joined by thin lines and a spiral icon in one corner.
cards.hero_colors: blue paper, white lines, small yellow stars

cards.name: Space Boots
cards.subject: A pair of chunky white space boots with thick grey soles and wide ankle cuffs, standing side by side.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey soles, small green strap on each cuff

cards.name: Radar Dish
cards.subject: A large white round satellite dish on a short sturdy cylindrical base, tilted up, with a short arm holding a small receiver at the dish centre.
cards.hero_colors: white, light grey, small red receiver tip

cards.name: Airlock
cards.subject: A perfectly round metal hatch door with a thick rim, bolts evenly around it and a central turning wheel, set into a white wall.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey, white wall, small orange wheel

cards.name: Control Desk
cards.subject: A curved grey control desk with a slanted panel of round buttons and sliders, and a wide screen on top showing a green radar circle icon.
cards.hero_colors: grey, black screen, green radar icon, small red buttons

cards.name: Retro Rocket
cards.subject: A slim silver rocket with a pointed nose, a round porthole, four swept fins at the base and a flat nozzle, flying upright.
cards.hero_colors: silver, red fins and nose, small yellow porthole

cards.name: Saucer
cards.subject: A perfectly round flying saucer: a wide disc with a smooth clear dome on top and three short round feet underneath.
cards.hero_colors: grey, silver, green dome, small orange light strip

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite with a gold foil box body, two rectangular solar panels attached left and right, and a small round dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: gold, dark blue panels, small white dish

cards.name: Microscope
cards.subject: A lab microscope with a curved grey arm, a round heavy base, a tube with an eyepiece on top, and a flat stage with a slide.
cards.hero_colors: grey, black, brass, small red focus knob

cards.name: Jetpack
cards.subject: A white backpack with two tall cylindrical tanks side by side, two shoulder straps and two cone nozzles at the bottom.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey nozzles, small orange stripe on the tanks

cards.name: Space Capsule
cards.subject: A cone-shaped capsule with a rounded base, a small round window and a flat heat shield, resting upright on sand.
cards.hero_colors: grey, silver, black heat shield, small orange stripe

cards.name: Plasma Ball
cards.subject: A perfectly round clear glass ball on a black round base, with glowing purple and pink lightning threads from the centre to the glass.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, purple, black base, small pink threads

cards.name: Launch Pad
cards.subject: A tall white rocket with a red nose cone and four fins standing upright on a round concrete pad with a short grey tower bolted to the pad beside it.
cards.hero_colors: white, red nose, grey tower, small yellow band

cards.name: Slide Door
cards.subject: A pair of sliding metal doors meeting in the middle of a white wall, with a tall glowing blue stripe in the gap and a round light above.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey, blue glowing stripe, white wall, small orange light

cards.name: Wall Screen
cards.subject: A large rectangular black screen fixed flat on a wall, showing a green circle radar icon with a sweep line and a few dots.
cards.hero_colors: black, green radar icon, grey frame, small yellow dots

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A chubby white rocket with an orange nose cone, a round window, three orange fins and a flat nozzle, flying upright.
cards.hero_colors: white, orange, small blue window

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A perfectly round silver flying saucer with a flat disc body, a smooth clear dome on top and a ring of round windows around the middle.
cards.hero_colors: silver, grey, green dome, small yellow windows

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite with a cube-shaped gold body, two long rectangular blue solar panels attached on both sides and a small round dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: gold, blue panels, small white dish

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white astronaut helmet with a large curved gold-mirrored visor and a thick neck ring.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold visor, small red neck ring stripe

cards.name: Mars Rover
cards.subject: A six-wheeled rover with a boxy white body, a flat solar panel on top and a tall mast with a small camera box, standing on sand.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey, black wheels, small orange panel trim

cards.name: Access Card
cards.subject: A flat rectangular white plastic card with rounded corners, a gold square chip and a blue stripe along one side, seen from above.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold chip, small blue stripe

cards.name: Flight Stick
cards.subject: A joystick with a round black base, a thick grey upright stick with a rounded grip and a trigger-free top button.
cards.hero_colors: black, grey, small red top button

cards.name: Observatory
cards.subject: A tall round white tower topped by a half-sphere dome with a narrow vertical slit opening and a short door at the base.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey, small orange door

cards.name: Porthole
cards.subject: A perfectly round window with a thick silver rim and evenly spaced bolts, set in a white wall, showing a deep blue night sky with small stars and a crescent moon.
cards.hero_colors: silver, white wall, deep blue glass, small yellow stars

cards.name: Airlock
cards.subject: A perfectly round metal hatch door with a thick rim, bolts evenly around it and a central turning wheel, set in a white wall.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey, white wall, small orange wheel
